g.desc: GPIO2 / GPIO3: USB host D+ / D- (PIO-USB, 22 ohm series). GPIO4 / GPIO5: UART1 TX / RX through the isolator.

g.text: GPIO14 / GPIO15 / GPIO28 / GPIO29: SPI1 SCK / MOSI / MISO and card CS. GPIO26: card detect. GPIO6: external RGB LED (J6).

g.desc: GPIO14 / GPIO15 / GPIO28 / GPIO29: SPI1 SCK / MOSI / MISO and card CS. GPIO26: card detect. GPIO6: external RGB LED (J6).

g.desc: GPIO24: PC 1 VBUS sense (10k / 20k divider). GPIO16 / 17 / 18: status LED red / green / blue.

g.text: side A (GND_A): adapter (J1) and PC 1 VBUS (J4) are OR-ed by D2 / D3 into +5V_SYS_A, which feeds the USB host port (through F1),

g.desc: side B (GND_B): PC 2 VBUS (J5) feeds LDO U52 (+3V3_B, MCU-B). The only link between the sides is the isolator U3.
